column1: # m3_primary_edge_ledger -- M3 PRIMARY CollecTRI signed-edge ledger v2 (SEAL CANDIDATE, TASK-028 Freeze B)
# AMENDMENT v2 per Vladimir DEC-M3-DUAL-EDGE. Supersedes v1 (which split ALL unresolved edges).
# ONE ROW PER ADMITTED PRIMARY EDGE (source-ledger order preserved).
#   consensus_sign = +1 if consensus_stimulation and not consensus_inhibition;
#                    unresolved otherwise (neither, or both consensus flags set).
#   An edge with a RESOLVED consensus sign PARTICIPATES ONCE in primary signed scoring with
#   that sign -- this INCLUDES both-flagged edges that resolved to a single consensus sign.
#   Edges with an UNRESOLVED consensus sign are EXCLUDED from primary signed scoring; they are
#   NOT split into activation+repression and are NOT assigned an arbitrary sign.
#   primary_inclusion=Y iff resolved; primary_sign=consensus sign if included, blank if excluded.
#   exclusion_reason: 'none' if included; else the TRUE reason
#   VIPER/aREA mode-of-regulation (MoR) = consensus sign (+1 activation, -1 repression).
#   weight = CollecTRI CONSENSUS confidence = 1.0 when the primary sign is a consensus call
#   (consensus_stimulation for +1, consensus_inhibition for -1); 0.5 for a non-consensus curated
#   call. weight blank for excluded (primary_inclusion=N) edges. evidence_class = CollecTRI-curated.
# PRE-FROZEN SENSITIVITY SETS (membership recorded here; NOTHING is scored in this ledger):
#   S1 flag-split (s1_representation): every both-flagged edge (all 79) = TWO contributions
#     (activation +1 and repression -1), each with its own consensus-confidence weight ->
#     s1_representation='split-dual'. Non-both-flagged consensus edges enter once -> 'single'.
#   S2 conservative exclusion (s2_inclusion): ALL both-flagged edges EXCLUDED (s2_inclusion=N);
# both_flagged = stimulation_flag AND inhibition_flag (raw CollecTRI is_stimulation/is_inhibition).
